_about: Gemma's openings for the built-in scenarios, written by tools/build_openings.py (the Openings workflow). Keys are Tutor.openingKey.

openings.ar-Learning-Airport-140ae93e:
REPLY: مرحباً! هل أنت مستعجل لرحلتك؟ يبدو أننا سننتظر قليلاً هنا.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you in a hurry for your trip? It looks like we'll be waiting a little here.
openings.ar-Learning-BusStop-a906de22:
REPLY: صباح الخير. هل أنتِ بانتظار حافلة؟
ENGLISH: Good morning. Are you waiting for a bus?
openings.ar-Learning-Coffee-1aa979e6:
REPLY: أهلاً! كيف حالك اليوم؟ تعال نجلس ونتحدث قليلاً.
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you today? Come, let's sit and talk a little.
openings.ar-Learning-Default-2b2288c6:
REPLY: هل أنت مستعد لتعلم بعض اللغة العربية؟ عن ماذا تود أن نتحدث اليوم؟
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Arabic? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ar-Learning-FirstDate-226a07a:
REPLY: أهلاً بك! الأجواء هنا رائعة، أليس كذلك؟ هل استمتعت بالطعام حتى الآن؟
ENGLISH: Welcome! The atmosphere here is wonderful, isn't it? Have you enjoyed the food so far?
openings.ar-Learning-Recommendations-2d5e6af2:
REPLY: أهلاً بك! أين أنت؟ هل تحتاج مساعدة في شيء ما؟
ENGLISH: Welcome! Where are you? Do you need help with anything?
openings.cs-Learning-Airport-3ecf871f:
REPLY: Dobrý den! Už se vám povedlo najít své místo na gate?
ENGLISH: Hello! Have you managed to find your seat at the gate yet?
openings.cs-Learning-BusStop-f1246a1:
REPLY: Dobrý den. Teď čekám na autobus, ale se mi zdá, že je trochu pozdě.
ENGLISH: Hello. I'm waiting for the bus now, but it seems a little late.
openings.cs-Learning-Coffee-8982f9e5:
REPLY: Ahoj! Tak, v końcu se na setkalo. Jak se máš, co děláš?
ENGLISH: Hi! So, we finally met. How are you, what are you doing?
openings.cs-Learning-Default-87c8310b:
REPLY: Jste připravený učit se česky? O čem byste dnes chtěl mluvit?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Czech? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.cs-Learning-FirstDate-fbb3af5b:
REPLY: Vítejte! Také mi se líbí toto místo. Jak se vám dneska podá?
ENGLISH: Welcome! I like this place too. How are you doing today?
openings.cs-Learning-Recommendations-3ef39953:
REPLY: Dobrý den! Poskytl vám mně nějakou pomoc, nebo se jen radíte?
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you providing me with some help, or are you just giving advice?
openings.da-Learning-Airport-62581781:
REPLY: Godmorgen! Er det travlt her på lufthavnen i dag?
ENGLISH: Good morning! Is it busy here at the airport today?
openings.da-Learning-BusStop-75bcbeff:
REPLY: Det er en ret travl morgen, ikke? Jeg håber, at bussen kommer snart.
ENGLISH: It's quite a busy morning, isn't it? I hope the bus comes soon.
openings.da-Learning-Coffee-9845143:
REPLY: Hej! Så er vi her. Det var længe siden, vi har set hinanden!
ENGLISH: Hi! So here we are. It's been a long time since we've seen each other!
openings.da-Learning-Default-4b827329:
REPLY: Er du klar til at lære lidt dansk? Hvad vil du gerne tale om i dag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn a little Danish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.da-Learning-FirstDate-953bc1bd:
REPLY: Det er hyggeligt at være her med dig. Hvad synes du om restauranten indtil nu?
ENGLISH: It's nice to be here with you. What do you think of the restaurant so far?
openings.da-Learning-Recommendations-b1cb9ab5:
REPLY: Hej! Kan jeg hjælpe dig med at finde noget at se eller spise i byen?
ENGLISH: Hi! Can I help you find something to watch or eat in town?
openings.de-Learning-Airport-2e47858c:
REPLY: Hallo! Bist du auch hier in der Warteschlange? Das Wetter ist heute wirklich schön, oder?
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you in the queue too? The weather is really nice today, isn't it?
openings.de-Learning-BusStop-5e3c5b14:
REPLY: Entschuldigung, kommt dieser Bus auch zur Innenstadt? Es ist heute ziemlich voll hier.
ENGLISH: Excuse me, does this bus also go to the city center? It's quite crowded here today.
openings.de-Learning-Coffee-d8f73fd8:
REPLY: Hallo! Schön, dich hier zu sehen. Möchtest du einen Kaffee trinken?
ENGLISH: Hello! Nice to see you here. Would you like to have a coffee?
openings.de-Learning-Default-5bf75054:
REPLY: Sind Sie bereit, etwas Deutsch zu lernen? Worüber möchten Sie heute sprechen?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some German? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.de-Learning-FirstDate-7bf36ac8:
REPLY: Hallo! Schön, dich hier kennenzulernen. Wie war dein Tag bisher?
ENGLISH: Hello! Nice to meet you here. How has your day been so far?
openings.de-Learning-Recommendations-633fee40:
REPLY: Hallo! Ich bin gerade dabei, durch die Gegend zu spazieren. Suchen Sie nach Empfehlungen für etwas in der Stadt?
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm just walking around. Are you looking for recommendations for something in the city?
openings.el-Learning-Airport-d1cf1e26:
REPLY: Καλημέρα! Για πάμε, πού πάμε σήμερα;
ENGLISH: Good morning! Let's go, where are we going today?
openings.el-Learning-BusStop-b706d03a:
REPLY: Καλημέρα! Αυτό είναι ένα μεγάλο ταξίδι, έτσι δεν είναι;
ENGLISH: Good morning! This is a big trip, isn't it?
openings.el-Learning-Coffee-afe637fe:
REPLY: Γεια σου! Πώς είσαι σήμερα; Πήρα ένα καφέ, хочешь να φάμε κάτι;
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you today? I got a coffee, do you want to eat something?
openings.el-Learning-Default-3699f4ec:
REPLY: Είσαι έτοιμος/έτοιμη να μάθεις ελληνικά; Τι θα ήθελες να μιλήσουμε σήμερα;
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Greek? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.el-Learning-FirstDate-f9423d62:
REPLY: Γεια σου! Ευχαριστώ πολύ για το καφέ. Πώς σου φαίνεται το μέρος;
ENGLISH: Hello! Thank you very much for the coffee. How do you like the place?
openings.el-Learning-Recommendations-2c5613da:
REPLY: Καλημέρα! Γι' όσες/για όσες έρχεσαι στην Αθήνα, είναι σωστό να ρωτάς. Πού σε λες να πάμε;
ENGLISH: Good morning! For those of you coming to Athens, it's right to ask. Where should I take you?
openings.en-Learning-Airport-75a593f6:
REPLY: It is quite crowded at this airport today, isn't it? I hope my flight to London isn't delayed.
ENGLISH: It's really busy at this airport today, isn't it? I hope my flight to London isn't late.
openings.en-Learning-BusStop-88d5286a:
REPLY: It looks like a bit of rain is coming! Are you waiting for the 42 bus as well?
ENGLISH: It looks like it's going to rain a little! Are you waiting for the 42 bus too?
openings.en-Learning-Coffee-188282e:
REPLY: Hey! It's great to finally see you. How have you been?
ENGLISH: Hey! It's great to finally see you. How have you been?
openings.en-Learning-Default-ca42fe5c:
REPLY: Are you ready to learn some English? What would you like to talk about today?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some English? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.en-Learning-FirstDate-94938332:
REPLY: This pasta dish looks amazing. How are you enjoying the evening so far?
ENGLISH: This pasta dish looks amazing. How are you enjoying the evening so far?
openings.en-Learning-Recommendations-bd1971aa:
REPLY: Hi there! You look a little lost. Are you looking for some recommendations while you're visiting?
ENGLISH: Hi there! You look a little lost. Are you looking for some recommendations while you're visiting?
openings.es-Learning-Airport-39f18602:
REPLY: Hola. ¿Es tu primera vez en este aeropuerto? Parece que el vuelo va a tardar un poco.
ENGLISH: Hello. Is this your first time at this airport? It looks like the flight is going to be a little late.
openings.es-Learning-BusStop-3e4cd2de:
REPLY: ¡Qué día tan soleado! ¿Vas en bus o caminas?
ENGLISH: What a sunny day! Are you taking the bus or walking?
openings.es-Learning-Coffee-6bbf2ca2:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Qué gusto verte, ¿cómo estás? Pide algo de tomar, ¡me encantaría ponerme al día contigo!
ENGLISH: Hi! It's great to see you, how are you? Order something to drink, I'd love to catch up with you!
openings.es-Learning-Default-ef482b70:
REPLY: ¿Estás listo para aprender español? ¿De qué te gustaría hablar hoy?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Spanish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.es-Learning-FirstDate-8f48413e:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Me alegro de que hayas venido. ¿Qué tal te ha ido el día hasta ahora?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm glad you came. How has your day been so far?
openings.es-Learning-Recommendations-7621e9b6:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Bienvenido a nuestra ciudad. ¿Qué tipo de recomendaciones estás buscando?
ENGLISH: Hello! Welcome to our city. What kind of recommendations are you looking for?
openings.fi-Learning-Airport-5835bf17:
REPLY: Hyvää päivää! Onko sinulla pitkä matka edessäsi?
ENGLISH: Good day! Do you have a long journey ahead of you?
openings.fi-Learning-BusStop-e9187ba9:
REPLY: Hyvää päivää. Onko tänään paljon ihmisiä bussipysäkille?
ENGLISH: Good day. Are there many people at the bus stop today?
openings.fi-Learning-Coffee-f2bcf2ed:
REPLY: Hei! Miltä päiväsi on ollut? Täällä on ihan mukava kahvilassa.
ENGLISH: Hi! How has your day been? It's really nice here in the cafe.
openings.fi-Learning-Default-61f74cd3:
REPLY: Oletko valmis oppimaan suomea? Mistä haluaisit tänään jutella?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Finnish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.fi-Learning-FirstDate-f3ed5f53:
REPLY: Hei! Onko tämä pöytä vapaa? Olen todella iloinen, että pääsimme tänne.
ENGLISH: Hi! Is this table free? I'm really happy we made it here.
openings.fi-Learning-Recommendations-b2c8cd4b:
REPLY: Hei! Mitä sinä haluaisit tietää? Olen paikallinen, niin voin auttaa sinua.
ENGLISH: Hi! What would you like to know? I'm local, so I can help you.
openings.fr-Learning-Airport-e7f3a148:
REPLY: Bonjour ! Vous partez pour quel voyage ? C'est votre premier vol avec cette compagnie ?
ENGLISH: Hello! Where are you traveling to? Is this your first flight with this airline?
openings.fr-Learning-BusStop-26e1ddd8:
REPLY: Bonjour ! Il fait beau aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ? Vous attendez le bus aussi ?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's nice out today, isn't it? Are you waiting for the bus too?
openings.fr-Learning-Coffee-b934c49c:
REPLY: Salut ! Ça fait un bail. Tu as pris le temps de venir ?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's been a while. Did you have time to come?
openings.fr-Learning-Default-a3b80e90:
REPLY: Êtes-vous prêt(e) à apprendre le français ? De quoi aimeriez-vous parler aujourd'hui ?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn French? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.fr-Learning-FirstDate-76e50284:
REPLY: Enchanté de vous rencontrer. Est-ce que vous avez déjà goûté à ce plat ?
ENGLISH: Nice to meet you. Have you ever tried this dish?
openings.fr-Learning-Recommendations-c93b67fc:
REPLY: Bonjour ! Vous avez l'air perdu(e), vous cherchez des recommandations pour visiter la ville ?
ENGLISH: Hello! You look lost, are you looking for recommendations for visiting the city?
openings.hi-Learning-Airport-4bf48dc:
REPLY: नमस्ते! क्या आप भी [हवाई अड्डे के नाम] जा रहे हैं? मैं भी [जगह का नाम] जा रहा हूँ।
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you also going to [airport name]? I am also going to [place name].
openings.hi-Learning-BusStop-5dd975c4:
REPLY: नमस्ते, क्या आप भी बस का इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं? आज काफी भीड़ है, है ना?
ENGLISH: Hello, are you waiting for the bus too? It's quite crowded today, isn't it?
openings.hi-Learning-Coffee-9f2d3288:
REPLY: अरे वाह! तुम आ गए! चलो, एक कप कॉफ़ी पीते हैं और बातें करते हैं।
ENGLISH: Oh wow! You're here! Come on, let's have a cup of coffee and chat.
openings.hi-Learning-Default-352be5c6:
REPLY: क्या आप कुछ हिंदी सीखने के लिए तैयार हैं? आज आप किस बारे में बात करना चाहेंगे?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Hindi? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.hi-Learning-FirstDate-40cb7e18:
REPLY: नमस्ते! यहाँ आकर आपको बहुत खुशी हुई। तो बताइए, आप यहाँ कैसा महसूस कर रहे हैं?
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm very happy to be here. So tell me, how are you feeling here?
openings.hi-Learning-Recommendations-b33b5990:
REPLY: नमस्ते! आप यहाँ घूमने आए हैं? क्या आप किसी अच्छी जगह के बारे में पूछना चाहते हैं?
ENGLISH: Hello! Have you come here to visit? Do you want to ask about a good place?
openings.hu-Learning-Airport-f78f46c3:
REPLY: Jó napot! Hol indulnak?
ENGLISH: Good day! Where are you heading?
openings.hu-Learning-BusStop-2cffec7d:
REPLY: Jó napot! Selyeleten, nem tudom, hogy hova megyek.
ENGLISH: Good day! I'm not sure where I'm going.
openings.hu-Learning-Coffee-4c05edc1:
REPLY: Szia! Sok örülök, hogy végre találkoztunk. Milyen a napod már most?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm so happy we finally met. How is your day going now?
openings.hu-Learning-Default-1ab8a6c7:
REPLY: Készenléten vagy magyarul tanyni? Mire szeretnél ma beszélgetni?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to talk in Hungarian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.hu-Learning-FirstDate-90ef52ff:
REPLY: Szia! Rendeztem ezt a helyet, mert hallottam, hogy nagyon jó ételük. Mit szeretnél örökségként?
ENGLISH: Hi! I booked this place because I heard their food is really good. What would you like as a treat?
openings.hu-Learning-Recommendations-ed4daaf7:
REPLY: Jó napot! Összenakoztam egy kis útkezőnek, szívesen segítek neked. Mire szeretnél menni?
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm a little guide, and I'd be happy to help you. Where would you like to go?
openings.id-Learning-Airport-155c5478:
REPLY: Wah, sepertinya penerbangannya sudah sebentar lagi ya. Anda mau ke mana hari ini?
ENGLISH: Wow, it looks like the flight is starting soon. Where are you going today?
openings.id-Learning-BusStop-ff65bca8:
REPLY: Wah, sudah jam segini busnya belum lewat ya? Cuacanya hari ini lumayan panas ya.
ENGLISH: Wow, it's this late and the bus hasn't come yet? The weather is quite hot today.
openings.id-Learning-Coffee-89988b6c:
REPLY: Hai! Akhirnya kita ketemu juga. Mau ngopi di sini saja?
ENGLISH: Hi! We finally met. Want to grab coffee here?
openings.id-Learning-Default-34a1f40:
REPLY: Apakah kamu siap belajar bahasa Indonesia? Kamu ingin bicara tentang apa hari ini?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Indonesian? What do you want to talk about today?
openings.id-Learning-FirstDate-af0be5b4:
REPLY: Selamat datang! Senang sekali kita bisa bertemu malam ini. Kamu sudah mencoba makanannya?
ENGLISH: Welcome! I'm so glad we could meet tonight. Have you tried the food?
openings.id-Learning-Recommendations-dfebb32c:
REPLY: Selamat siang! Mau tanya sesuatu, ya? Boleh saya bantu?
ENGLISH: Good afternoon! I want to ask something, okay? Can I help you?
openings.it-Learning-Airport-1536e2a6:
REPLY: Ciao! Sembra che la fila per la sicurezza sia lunghissima oggi. Sei in viaggio per qualcosa di speciale?
ENGLISH: Hi! It looks like the security line is really long today. Are you traveling for something special?
openings.it-Learning-BusStop-5fd9bbba:
REPLY: Buongiorno! Che bella giornata per aspettare il bus, vero?
ENGLISH: Good morning! What a beautiful day to wait for the bus, isn't it?
openings.it-Learning-Coffee-11fae37e:
REPLY: Ciao! Sono felice di vederti! Come stai oggi?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm happy to see you! How are you today?
openings.it-Learning-Default-b421082c:
REPLY: Sei pronto a imparare l'italiano? Di cosa ti piacerebbe parlare oggi?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Italian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.it-Learning-FirstDate-e0f681e2:
REPLY: Ciao! È un piacere conoscerti. Cosa ne pensi del posto?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's nice to meet you. What do you think of the place?
openings.it-Learning-Recommendations-ccf0185a:
REPLY: Ciao! Benvenuto/a in città! Come posso aiutarti con i tuoi consigli?
ENGLISH: Hi! Welcome to the city! How can I help you with your advice?
openings.nl-Learning-Airport-4b271b1e:
REPLY: Goedendag! Hoe is uw vlucht naar [Bestemming]? Ik hoop dat alles goed gaat.
ENGLISH: Good day! How is your flight to [Destination]? I hope everything is going well.
openings.nl-Learning-BusStop-329f2042:
REPLY: Goedemorgen! Best drukke ochtend vandaag, hè?
ENGLISH: Good morning! It's a busy morning today, isn't it?
openings.nl-Learning-Coffee-75f7cc06:
REPLY: Hoi! Hoe gaat het met je? Ik wilde even bijpraten terwijl we koffie drinken.
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? I wanted to catch up while we drink coffee.
openings.nl-Learning-Default-b0b1134:
REPLY: Ben je klaar om wat Nederlands te leren? Waar wil je vandaag over praten?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Dutch? What do you want to talk about today?
openings.nl-Learning-FirstDate-8e02b25a:
REPLY: Hallo! Het is leuk om je hier te ontmoeten. Wat denk je van dit restaurant?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's nice to meet you here. What do you think of this restaurant?
openings.nl-Learning-Recommendations-1d1f8cd2:
REPLY: Hallo! Wat kan ik voor je doen? Je kijkt alsof je hulp nodig hebt met een paar aanbevelingen.
ENGLISH: Hello! What can I do for you? You look like you need some help with some recommendations.
openings.no-Learning-Airport-2f82f230:
REPLY: Hei! Er du også på vei til Oslo i dag? Det er ganske travelt her på ankomsthallen.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you heading to Oslo today too? It's pretty busy here in the arrival hall.
openings.no-Learning-BusStop-933933f0:
REPLY: Hei! Er du også her for bussen til Oslo? Det er alltid så travelt her om morgenen.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you here for the bus to Oslo too? It's always so busy here in the morning.
openings.no-Learning-Coffee-281ae6b4:
REPLY: Hei! Det er så kjekt å se deg her. Skal vi ta en kopp kaffe?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's so nice to see you here. Shall we have a cup of coffee?
openings.no-Learning-Default-27115d2:
REPLY: Er du klar for å lære litt norsk? Hva vil du gjerne snakke om i dag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Norwegian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.no-Learning-FirstDate-12a7bb6c:
REPLY: Hei! Takk for at du kom. Kanskje vi kan bestille noe å drikke først?
ENGLISH: Hi! Thanks for coming. Maybe we can order something to drink first?
openings.no-Learning-Recommendations-f50c2ce4:
REPLY: Hei! Velkommen til Oslo! Hva vil du se og spise her?
ENGLISH: Hi! Welcome to Oslo! What do you want to see and eat here?
openings.pl-Learning-Airport-9c7cf04d:
REPLY: Cześć! Czy czekasz na samolot? Jest trochę tłoczno tutaj.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you waiting for a plane? It's a bit crowded here.
openings.pl-Learning-BusStop-ed2b8ab3:
REPLY: Dzień dobry! Czy długo tu czekamy na autobus?
ENGLISH: Good morning! How long are we waiting for the bus?
openings.pl-Learning-Coffee-d6f516f7:
REPLY: Cześć! Fajnie Cię widzieć! Jak się masz?
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to see you! How are you?
openings.pl-Learning-Default-4c85e475:
REPLY: Czy jesteś gotów, żeby nauczyć się polskiego? O czym chciałbyś dziś porozmawiać?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Polish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.pl-Learning-FirstDate-2d7c2689:
REPLY: Cześć! Bardzo miło cię poznać. Jak ci smakuje to jedzenie?
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to meet you. How is the food?
openings.pl-Learning-Recommendations-53185981:
REPLY: Dzień dobry! Czy szukasz jakichś dobrych miejsc w okolicy? Chętnie pomogę!
ENGLISH: Good morning! Are you looking for any good places nearby? I'd be happy to help!
openings.pt-Learning-Airport-176c0e39:
REPLY: Olá! Está a aguardar por algum voo? Parece que está a ser um dia agitado aqui no aeroporto.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you waiting for a flight? It seems like it's a busy day here at the airport.
openings.pt-Learning-BusStop-dae63d47:
REPLY: Bom dia! Parece que vamos ter um dia agitado hoje, não é?
ENGLISH: Good morning! Looks like we're going to have a busy day today, don't we?
openings.pt-Learning-Coffee-2b78338b:
REPLY: Oi! Que bom te ver. Como você tem passado?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's good to see you. How have you been?
openings.pt-Learning-Default-99b7bee1:
REPLY: Está pronto para aprender um pouco de português? Sobre o que você gostaria de conversar hoje?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn a little Portuguese? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.pt-Learning-FirstDate-7f2df075:
REPLY: Oi! É um prazer finalmente te conhecer. Este restaurante é ótimo, não acha?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's a pleasure to finally meet you. This restaurant is great, don't you think?
openings.pt-Learning-Recommendations-dd25ed6d:
REPLY: Olá! Sou daqui mesmo, então posso te dar algumas dicas ótimas. O que você gostaria de ver ou comer por aqui?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm from here, so I can give you some great tips. What would you like to see or eat around here?
openings.ro-Learning-Airport-15e1ab45:
REPLY: O zi lungă, nu-i așa? Să vedem ce se întâmplă la acest zbor.
ENGLISH: A long day, isn't it? Let's see what happens on this flight.
openings.ro-Learning-BusStop-dcda5cbb:
REPLY: Bună ziua! Este destul de aglomerat astăzi, nu credeți?
ENGLISH: Good day! It's quite busy today, don't you think?
openings.ro-Learning-Coffee-14ae2cff:
REPLY: Salut! E bine să te văd! Ai vrea să ne comandăm ceva?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's good to see you! Do you want to order something?
openings.ro-Learning-Default-56760b6d:
REPLY: Ești gata să înveți română? Despre ce ai vrea să vorbim astăzi?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Romanian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ro-Learning-FirstDate-41e75981:
REPLY: Ești foarte dulce! Uită-te, am comandat deja un vin roșu, dar poate vrei să vezi ce am ales eu.
ENGLISH: You are very sweet! Look, I already ordered a red wine, but maybe you want to see what I chose.
openings.ro-Learning-Recommendations-170d9079:
REPLY: Bună! Ești turist și cauți sugestii? Cu plăcere te ajut!
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you a tourist looking for suggestions? I'd be happy to help!
openings.ru-Learning-Airport-904893f:
REPLY: Здравствуйте! Вы не подскажете, во сколько сегодня вылет? Я вот только пришел и немного потерялся.
ENGLISH: Hello! Could you tell me what time the flight is today? I just arrived and I'm a little lost.
openings.ru-Learning-BusStop-34445081:
REPLY: Какая сегодня хорошая погода, правда? Вы часто здесь ждете автобус?
ENGLISH: The weather is nice today, isn't it? Do you often wait for the bus here?
openings.ru-Learning-Coffee-1604f3c5:
REPLY: Привет! Как дела? Рада тебя наконец-то увидеть!
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? I'm so glad to finally see you!
openings.ru-Learning-Default-31293a6b:
REPLY: Вы готовы выучить по-русски? О чем бы вы хотели поговорить сегодня?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Russian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ru-Learning-FirstDate-1f9cd17b:
REPLY: Привет! Рад с тобой познакомиться. Как тебе это место?
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to meet you. How do you like this place?
openings.ru-Learning-Recommendations-7d9dab73:
REPLY: Здравствуйте! Вы что-то спрашиваете? Чем я могу вам помочь?
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you asking something? How can I help you?
openings.sk-Learning-Airport-a4ae0cf8:
REPLY: Dobrý deň, má pre vás miesto v letisku? Je mi trochu nudno čakať na let.
ENGLISH: Hello, do you have a seat for me at the airport? I'm a bit bored waiting for the flight.
openings.sk-Learning-BusStop-3323428:
REPLY: Dobre ráno! Čakáme na ten autobus, že? Je dnes tak slnečné.
ENGLISH: Good morning! We're waiting for that bus, right? It's so sunny today.
openings.sk-Learning-Coffee-794cc2ec:
REPLY: Ahoj! Už sme si sedli do kavárne? Jak to pre teba prebiehá dnes?
ENGLISH: Hi! Have we sat down in the cafe yet? How is your day going?
openings.sk-Learning-Default-f3c88c40:
REPLY: Ste sú pripravený učiť sa po slovensky? O čom by ste dnes chceli hovoriť?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Slovak? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sk-Learning-FirstDate-15de1e34:
REPLY: Ahoj! Je super, že sa môme stretnúť. Je tu príliš ramai ľudí, nie?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's great that we can meet. There are too many people here, aren't there?
openings.sk-Learning-Recommendations-7de9abac:
REPLY: Dobrý deň! Môžete mi pomôcť? Hľadám nejaké dobré miestami na obedu alebo na prechádzky.
ENGLISH: Hello! Can you help me? I'm looking for some good places for lunch or for a walk.
openings.sl-Learning-Airport-dfe5386d:
REPLY: Zdravo! Ali ste vi tudi za to leteče letalo? Mislim, da bo malo časa do letala.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you also for that flying car? I think it will be a while until the car.
openings.sl-Learning-BusStop-89508e93:
REPLY: Dobr dan. Je počasen dan za vas?
ENGLISH: Good day. Is it a pleasant day for you?
openings.sl-Learning-Coffee-eef70ad7:
REPLY: Zdravo! Kakor ti je bilo? Mi smo se že dolgo ne videli.
ENGLISH: Hello! How have you been? We haven't seen each other in a long time.
openings.sl-Learning-Default-2536f18d:
REPLY: Ali ste pripravljeni se naučiti nekaj slovenskega? O čemer bi danes želeli govoriti?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Slovenian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sl-Learning-FirstDate-fd3e8ea9:
REPLY: Zdravo! Kako si bil na poti sem? Ta restavracija je zelo lepa, ne misliš?
ENGLISH: Hello! How was your journey? This restaurant is very nice, don't you think?
openings.sl-Learning-Recommendations-ae58b1a1:
REPLY: Zdravo! Dobro tekom? Kaj pa te zanima, si v mestu v posetu?
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you? What interests you, are you visiting the city?
openings.sr-Learning-Airport-54a3862:
REPLY: Dobro jutro! Šalje li vas neka putovanja danas?
ENGLISH: Good morning! Are you going on any trips today?
openings.sr-Learning-BusStop-38e1c47e:
REPLY: Dobro jutro! Možete li verovatno da se ovo budeš autobusom do centra?
ENGLISH: Good morning! Can you probably take this bus to the center?
openings.sr-Learning-Coffee-f4cdee42:
REPLY: Zdravo! Drago mi je što smo se uspjeli naći. Kako si, šta si radila ovih dana?
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm glad we managed to find each other. How are you, what have you been up to these days?
openings.sr-Learning-Default-8e60a210:
REPLY: Da li ste spremni da naučite nešto srpskog? O čemu biste želeli da razgovarate danas?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Serbian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sr-Learning-FirstDate-6229539e:
REPLY: Drago mi je što sam te upoznao! Da li si već probao nešto od ovde?
ENGLISH: I'm glad I met you! Have you tried anything from here yet?
openings.sr-Learning-Recommendations-a32fcc16:
REPLY: Dobro jutro! Ako tražite preporuke, rado ću vam pomoći. Šta vas zanima, gde biste želeli da idete?
ENGLISH: Good morning! If you're looking for recommendations, I'd be happy to help. What are you interested in, where would you like to go?
openings.sv-Learning-Airport-fa7f8a57:
REPLY: Hej! Är du på väg någon speciell ställe idag?
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you going anywhere special today?
openings.sv-Learning-BusStop-d2856869:
REPLY: Det är en riktigt solig dag idag, eller hur? Jag hoppas att bussen kommer snart.
ENGLISH: It's a really sunny day today, isn't it? I hope the bus comes soon.
openings.sv-Learning-Coffee-bb1e3fad:
REPLY: Hej! Vad kul att du kom. Sätt dig ner, så tar vi en kopp kaffe.
ENGLISH: Hi! It's nice that you came. Have a seat, and we'll have a cup of coffee.
openings.sv-Learning-Default-9f8faf93:
REPLY: Är du redo att lära dig lite svenska? Vad skulle du vilja prata om idag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Swedish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sv-Learning-FirstDate-d566a93:
REPLY: Vad kul att träffas här! Hur är din mat så här?
ENGLISH: It's fun to meet here! How is your food?
openings.sv-Learning-Recommendations-fd40388b:
REPLY: Hej! Kan jag hjälpa dig med något? Du ser ut som en turist.
ENGLISH: Hi! Can I help you with anything? You look like a tourist.
openings.sw-Learning-Airport-b95f8637:
REPLY: Habari yako? Unaelekea kwenda wapi leo?
ENGLISH: How are you? Where are you going today?
openings.sw-Learning-BusStop-4ff9a089:
REPLY: Habari yako? Je, unapenda kusubiri basi hapa?
ENGLISH: How are you? Do you like waiting for the bus here?
openings.sw-Learning-Coffee-12b387cd:
REPLY: Mambo vipi rafiki? Karibu! Nimefurahi sana kukutana nawe leo.
ENGLISH: How are you, friend? Welcome! I am very happy to meet you today.
openings.sw-Learning-Default-619180b3:
REPLY: Je, uko tayari kujifunza Kiswahili? Ungependa kuzungumzia nini leo?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Swahili? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sw-Learning-FirstDate-9e604673:
REPLY: Habari yako? Chakula hapa ni vizuri sana, unahisi vipi leo?
ENGLISH: How are you? The food here is very good, how are you feeling today?
openings.sw-Learning-Recommendations-6ea246b:
REPLY: Habari yako rafiki! Karibu sana, unaweza kuniuliza chochote. Unatafuta mambo gani hapa mji?
ENGLISH: Hello friend! You are very welcome, you can ask me anything. What are you looking for here in town?
openings.tr-Learning-Airport-f90f0272:
REPLY: Merhaba, nereye uçuyorsunuz? Uçuşumuz biraz gecikti galiba.
ENGLISH: Hello, where are you flying to? Our flight seems to be a bit delayed.
openings.tr-Learning-BusStop-a8cde06e:
REPLY: Günaydın, hava ne kadar güzel değil mi? Bu otobüs beklemek biraz sıkıcı olabiliyor.
ENGLISH: Good morning, isn't the weather beautiful? Waiting for this bus can be a bit boring.
openings.tr-Learning-Coffee-73858232:
REPLY: Selam! Nasılsın, ne zamandır görüşemedik? Gel otur şöyle, bir kahve içelim.
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you, it's been a while since we saw each other? Come sit down, let's have a coffee.
openings.tr-Learning-Default-18f1b180:
REPLY: Türkçe öğrenmeye hazır mısın? Bugün ne hakkında konuşmak istersin?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Turkish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.tr-Learning-FirstDate-b2212dae:
REPLY: Nasılsın? Bu mekânı beğendin mi?
ENGLISH: How are you? Did you like this place?
openings.tr-Learning-Recommendations-70f39e26:
REPLY: Merhaba! Şehri mi geziyorsun? Sana yardımcı olabilirim.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you touring the city? I can help you.
openings.uk-Learning-Airport-d4ae606a:
REPLY: Доброго дня! Ви звертаєте увагу, як довго ми чекаємо на наш рейс?
ENGLISH: Good day! Are you noticing how long we've been waiting for our flight?
openings.uk-Learning-BusStop-1cb52f76:
REPLY: Доброго дня! Я не знав, що тут хтось чекає. Ви також чекаєте на автобус?
ENGLISH: Good day! I didn't know anyone was waiting here. Are you waiting for the bus too?
openings.uk-Learning-Coffee-773d953a:
REPLY: Привіт! Рада тебе бачити! Ходімо, сідаємо за столик, я вже замовляла каву.
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm glad to see you! Let's go, sit down at the table, I've already ordered coffee.
openings.uk-Learning-Default-98254588:
REPLY: Ви готові вивчати українську? Чотів би ви поговорити сьогодні?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Ukrainian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.uk-Learning-FirstDate-731a03a6:
REPLY: Привіт! Рада, що ти прийшов. Мені подобається це місце, ти тут вже був?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm glad you came. I like this place, have you been here before?
openings.uk-Learning-Recommendations-d954f81e:
REPLY: Доброго дня! Ви згаяли щось? Якась допомога вам потрібна?
ENGLISH: Good day! Did you lose something? Do you need any help?
openings.vi-Learning-Airport-676cc117:
REPLY: Chào bạn, bạn đang chờ chuyến bay đi đâu vậy? Tôi cũng đang đợi ở đây.
ENGLISH: Hi, where are you waiting for a flight to? I'm waiting here too.
openings.vi-Learning-BusStop-22a639a9:
REPLY: Trời, hôm nay đông quá ha. Bạn có đợi xe buýt tuyến nào không?
ENGLISH: Wow, it's so crowded today, isn't it? Are you waiting for a bus?
openings.vi-Learning-Coffee-24d9b0ed:
REPLY: Chào bạn, mình mừng vì cuối cùng chúng mình cũng có dịp gặp nhau ở quán cà phê này! Bạn đã gọi món gì chưa?
ENGLISH: Hi, I'm glad we finally got to meet at this coffee shop! Have you ordered anything yet?
openings.vi-Learning-Default-56a719ff:
REPLY: Bạn đã sẵn sàng học tiếng Việt chưa? Hôm nay bạn muốn nói về chủ đề gì?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Vietnamese? What topic do you want to talk about today?
openings.vi-Learning-FirstDate-e3466153:
REPLY: Chào bạn, mình rất vui được gặp bạn hôm nay. Bạn có thích món khai vị này không?
ENGLISH: Hello, I'm very happy to meet you today. Do you like this appetizer?
openings.vi-Learning-Recommendations-a8c0cf4b:
REPLY: Chào bạn! Bạn muốn đi đâu à? Để mình giúp bạn nhé.
ENGLISH: Hi! Where do you want to go? Let me help you.
openings.zh-Learning-Airport-cd48bf5a:
REPLY: 你好！我们好像都在等同一班飞机，是去哪里旅行呢？
ENGLISH: Hello! It seems we're both waiting for the same flight. Where are you traveling to?
openings.zh-Learning-BusStop-a7fb4a86:
REPLY: 你好，这公交车应该要晚点了，对吧？天气真不错啊！
ENGLISH: Hello, this bus should be late, right? The weather is really nice!
openings.zh-Learning-Coffee-db6bb84a:
REPLY: 嗨！很高兴见到你！我们坐下来喝杯咖啡吧。
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to meet you! Let's sit down and have a coffee.
openings.zh-Learning-Default-9ad92fa2:
REPLY: 你准备好学习中文了吗？你今天想聊些什么呢？
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Chinese? What would you like to chat about today?
openings.zh-Learning-FirstDate-31ba5296:
REPLY: 你好，很高兴能在这里和你约会。你觉得这家餐厅的菜怎么样？
ENGLISH: Hi, I'm happy to be on a date with you here. What do you think of the food at this restaurant?
openings.zh-Learning-Recommendations-5e24cf0e:
REPLY: 你好！我是本地人。你是在找推荐嗎？
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm a local. Are you looking for recommendations?
